## Structured fields

Schema for the external identifiers of a strain. These fields hold rows validated against a published schema; the form shows them as a table, the API returns them as stored. The fields of each row:

### External Identifiers

Add external identifiers from databases like NCBI, JAX, DOI, etc. Include URLs when available.

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `Source` | **Required.** Choice. Options: NCBI, JAX, MGI, RGD, BDSC, FlyBase, ZFIN, RBRC, IMSR, Criver, Taconic, Envigo, Harlan, DOI, Custom, Other. |
| `Identifier` | **Required.** Text. |
| `URL (optional)` | Text. |

The schemas are published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/Strain/` (see [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/)); the API view with property codes is on the [Strain API page](/api/taxonomies/strain/#json-field-schemas).
